claims.decision_rule: After the SD1 and SD2 synthetic oracles hold, an independent review exists and a G4 lease exists, one run is classified by the frozen table: INVALID if leakage, a dataset or protocol digest mismatch, an available_at violation or contact with the FS1 warm-up span or sealed window occurs; NO_SIGNAL if no family-by-model cell is positive and BH-significant (q = 0.10, frozen one-sided equal-weighted cosine Student-t p-values) on both the raw and the cross-sectionally demeaned target with a positive demeaned increment in all four eligible full years 2022-2025; SIGNAL_NOT_TRADABLE if signal cells exist but none has a cost-x1 interval of the payoff relative to the zero-cost drift-sign policy strictly above zero with a positive cost-x2 point; SIGNAL_CANDIDATE otherwise, keeping at most three cells ranked by interval lower bound. Every label stays known-used exploratory screening and is never an edge
forbidden: any edge, profitability, G4, G5, unused-data, final-evaluation, live-trading or production claim
running SD2 or any later real-data step, reading or computing any market value, fitting or replaying before a separate owner G4 lease and an independent review of this exact digest and heads
touching 2026-08-01T00:00Z onward (the FS1 warm-up span or the sealed window)

adding or changing a feature family, horizon, target, model, penalty, k, cost multiplier, threshold, block length or candidate cap after any result is seen without a new protocol version and a recorded exploration history
reading a SIGNAL_CANDIDATE label as an edge

calling any result beta-robust or beta-adjusted: the decisive target removes only the same-time cross-sectional mean, and the D4 payoff is relative to a zero-cost drift-sign policy, not a beta-adjusted alpha
running the runner from a dirty working tree, without a G4 authorization comment URL, with another plan or protocol digest, or on a Dataset other than the pinned development Dataset
treating the G4 authorization URL as authenticated: the runner cannot verify its author
rerunning after a result, or re-running with a changed cell, plan or threshold, without a new protocol version

authorities.accounting: none in SD0; D4 uses a simple payoff and is not the canonical ledger; native replay is limited to at most three frozen candidates in a later card
authorities.evidence: content-addressed protocol digest; single run with every cell saved; verdict is a pure function of saved cell evidence under frozen thresholds
authorities.execution: simple fee plus spread on both sides, no impact, latency, funding or capacity; not the native executor
authorities.risk: no risk layer or sizing; unit exposure only; hard risk is not exercised and not claimed
authorities.sign: positive rank-IC increment over the drift baseline on the raw and the cross-sectionally demeaned target; payoff is signed position times return minus absolute position times round-trip cost, and D4 compares it with a zero-cost drift-sign policy
authorities.state: no account or book state; the diagnosis is at signal level and holds no position state
authorities.time: dataset available_at not later than the decision timestamp; a label is usable only after t+h matures inside the window on the bar-close-time basis; the window ends where the FS1 warm-up span begins, derived from the FS1 registry; a decisive stability year must start at or after the first usable fit and end inside the window
authorities.unit: forward log return over h hourly bars; costs in basis points of notional; exposure is one signed unit

evidence.counterexample: A protocol with a shrunken penalty grid and a matching digest; a payload carrying an edge, G4 or live field; a signal cell without D4 evidence; one tampered byte; a duplicate JSON key; p-values with foreign or missing provenance (another test, including the superseded v3 bootstrap); a p-value below 1.0 for a series of zero to three days; a protocol whose long-run variance span or bootstrap block is shorter than the label overlap or whose BH family is not the decision cells; a test that treats its variance estimate as known and so rejects a true null too often
evidence.known_limitations: Software-level on synthetic inputs; a frozen digest proves the declaration cannot change silently, not that the declared design is sound, and this packet is UNREVIEWED
evidence.oracle: tests/evaluation/test_signal_diagnosis_run_scenarios.py recomputes nothing from the runner: it plants a known signal, noise and a below-cost signal in seeded synthetic panels and checks the verdict label and cells, that every cell is saved and a failed cell halts without a verdict, that the output is byte-identical on a second run, and that the provenance the runner attests (procedure id, eligible days, EWC p-value) equals the saved cell record and is accepted by the merged verdict but refused when tampered; tests/evaluation/test_signal_diagnosis_run_units.py pins the array training set, the Ridge from moments and the grouped IC to the shared implementations
evidence.statement: The verdict is a pure function of saved cell evidence under thresholds frozen with a digest; changing a grid, threshold or window, loading a protocol with a claim field, or classifying incomplete evidence fails closed. The Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment is computed inside the verdict, separately for the raw and the demeaned target, over exactly the 16 frozen decision cells from raw one-sided p-values that carry the frozen procedure's provenance; an already adjusted p-value cannot be supplied, and a series too short for the frozen test (fewer than four days, including none) must carry a p-value of exactly 1.0

execution.counterexample: A zero-cost or one-sided-cost rule, a rule that trades below the threshold, a payoff that omits the round-trip charge
execution.known_limitations: A simple cost model without impact, funding, borrow, latency, capacity or a risk layer, and not the canonical ledger; an after-cost screening payoff is not a P&L and a candidate would still need native replay and a prospective test
execution.oracle: tests/evaluation/test_signal_diagnosis_protocol.py checks the cost fields against the development protocol fee and spread and the 2*(fee+spread) identity; SD1 must supply a slow independent reference for signed position times return minus absolute position times round-trip cost on hand-checkable rows
execution.statement: The after-cost screen charges fee 5 bp plus spread 2 bp per side (round trip 14 bp) at cost multipliers 1 and 2, only when the forecast exceeds k times the round-trip cost, and charges nothing while flat; the comparator drift-sign policy is charged nothing

sign.oracle: SD1 must show on seeded synthetic data with known truth: planted-signal recovery; shuffled-future null with FDR control; common-level-only market with demeaned IC near zero, plus a heterogeneous-beta control that documents what demeaning does not remove; tail-only signal with rank-versus-linear IC divergence. SD0 checks only, on hand-written numbers in tests/evaluation/test_signal_diagnosis_verdict.py, that the rule rejects a cell whose demeaned IC is zero, negative or not BH-significant

thesis.cheapest_falsifier: Before any market value is read: seeded synthetic panels over the whole protocol window with the real roster and the 167 feature names and a known truth (tests/evaluation/test_signal_diagnosis_run_scenarios.py): a planted signal must give SIGNAL_CANDIDATE only for the family it was planted in, pure noise NO_SIGNAL, a signal below the round-trip cost SIGNAL_NOT_TRADABLE, a feature that copies the label and a builder that reads the future must set the leakage flag and make the verdict INVALID, and the p-value provenance the runner attests must be accepted by the merged verdict and refused when tampered. Unit pins (tests/evaluation/test_signal_diagnosis_run_units.py) show the array training set equals the shared causal builder, the Ridge from moments equals the shared fit, the grouped IC equals the SD1 daily IC, a bar after 2026-08-01T00:00Z is refused and a real run without a G4 URL, from a dirty tree or on another Dataset identity does not compute; tests/evaluation/test_signal_diagnosis_run_cli.py spies on the payload reader and proves the CLI never reaches it, before any array is read, when the manifest puts coverage past the window, on a missing G4 URL, a dirty tree, a missing LightGBM or any digest mismatch, and reaches it exactly once for a valid input. For the economic question the cheapest falsifier is the single preregistered NO_SIGNAL outcome
thesis.counter_hypothesis: Counterfactuals: the drift baseline (expanding mean, monthly update), the cross-sectionally demeaned target, the year, regime and extreme-day slices and the SD1 shuffled-future null separate a real signal from its alternatives. H0a: predictive power is indistinguishable from the drift baseline, so the #1025 outcome is explained on the data side. H0b: apparent predictive power is explained by the common cross-sectional level or market direction, a few extreme days, concentration in particular years or symbols, or feature non-stationarity such as a funding_bps drift. H0c: a statistical signal exists but does not exceed round-trip cost
thesis.economic_mechanism: Causal story: if the current features carry usable information about relative returns of the five USDT-M perpetuals (return and oscillator momentum or reversal, trend, volatility and range state, volume and flow, funding and crowding, cross-asset relative strength), a time-ordered out-of-sample fit should rank future returns better than the drift baseline even after the same-time cross-sectional mean is removed, and a large enough forecast should pay for the round trip. The diagnosis does not assume any mechanism is true; it tests whether any information survives before a new learner is tried
thesis.final_decision: Objective: decide whether the SD2 runner (trade_rl/evaluation/signal_diagnosis_run) applies the frozen signal_diagnosis_protocol_v4 (SHA-256 1f48b065b03bc38299a751bef89456b57d5afc6a7d8b917668b1b461f852d0b3, Issue #1146) exactly, and is fit to support a later request to the owner for a separate G4 lease to run it once on the consumed development Dataset. Operational target: whether further decision-learning work on the current features (the #1025 line) is justified or new information sources are needed. This packet authorizes no real-data execution, fit, replay, FS1 scoring, unused or final data read, or live order
thesis.hypothesis: Issue #1146 (parent #810, follow-up of #1025). H1: at least one preregistered feature family has out-of-sample rank-IC predictive power above the drift baseline (expanding mean, monthly update) at the 24-bar horizon that remains after removing the same-time cross-sectional mean (the common level; heterogeneous market beta is not removed), has a positive increment in each of the four full calendar years 2022-2025 (2021, whose model decisions start in April, and the truncated 2026 are partial and reported only, and a full year counts only with 12 covered months), and under a simple threshold rule earns an after-cost payoff relative to a zero-cost drift-sign policy (not a beta-adjusted alpha) whose 95% 20-day moving-block-bootstrap interval excludes zero at 1x round-trip cost and whose point estimate is positive at 2x. Frozen as signal_diagnosis_protocol_v4 (SHA-256 1f48b065b03bc38299a751bef89456b57d5afc6a7d8b917668b1b461f852d0b3, report/issue1146-sd0-signal-diagnosis-protocol-v4-20261111.json). Dataset id 0b95547145a8f35d4deaaea99479ccf93244080bff52ef969203f4fa721de174. Reused-development evidence only: the dataset is consumed development data through 2026-08-01, so any later result is a known-used, post hoc exploratory screening result; no result value exists for this packet
thesis.information_gain: One preregistered pass separates four outcomes that call for different work: INVALID (fix and discard), NO_SIGNAL (stop the #1025 learner line on current features and look for new information sources), SIGNAL_NOT_TRADABLE (work on horizon, turnover and execution cost) and SIGNAL_CANDIDATE (freeze at most three candidates for a separate prospective validation request). On consumed data it can narrow the search; it cannot show an edge
thesis.limitations: Assumptions: the five USDT-M perpetuals and 167 maintained features are the relevant universe; hourly bars with 24-bar labels are an adequate unit; a fee-plus-spread cost is a fair first screen. Development use: screening only, never selection of a production strategy. Unused-data policy: no unused data is touched, consumed data never returns to unused, and the FS1 warm-up span and sealed window are refused. Known-used and post hoc: the development dataset was consumed by earlier studies and the plan author has seen recorded aggregate results on it (#1025 TD8, the M38 forecast diagnostic and a local breakeven report) which motivated the demeaning and tail checks, so the protocol is not blind to those aggregates and no result can be an out-of-sample or unused-data claim. Author interpretations fixed in the protocol and open to reviewer challenge: the verdict corners the plan leaves unassigned (a year-unstable signal is NO_SIGNAL; an interval excluding zero with a non-positive 2x point, or an interval wholly below zero, is SIGNAL_NOT_TRADABLE); decision cells are family-by-model at the 24-bar horizon with the standardise-and-clip transform and k = 1; BH is applied over the 16 decision cells; the cost-adjusted sign payoff target is the net payoff of a unit signed position; the first fit is 2021-04-01 so 2021 is a partial reported-only year and all four full years 2022-2025 must be positive (four of four, stricter than the plan's four of five, fixed result-blind after the review findings; a year with fewer than 12 covered months of at least 15 valid daily increments is ineligible and fails closed to NO_SIGNAL); the demeaned target removes only the common level and not heterogeneous market beta, and the beta-regression baseline is reported context that never decides; the drift-sign comparator is charged no cost, a deliberately favourable choice, and the D4 payoff relative to it is not a beta-adjusted alpha; 30 days stands for monthly; the inner CV has 5 forward-chaining folds purged by the label horizon; daily IC is pooled over the day's rows; families are defined by indicator kind and are arbitrary; five symbols and overlapping 24-hour labels give far fewer independent observations than rows; bars stamped 2026-08-01T00:00Z close the last development period and are inside the window. Prior exposure, cited from Issue #1146 section 1 and not recomputed here: a local breakeven report outside the repository (24-hour Ridge, alpha 10, 2020-01 to 2026-08) recorded a pooled IC of 0.0675, a rank IC of 0.0164 and a daily t of 2.31, and the M38 forecast diagnostic (Ridge, 2024-03) recorded mse_skill -0.017588, so the design is not blind to the gap between pooled and rank IC that motivated the tail check. Power trade-off, deliberate: the persistence rule is 4 of 4 full years, stricter than the plan's 4 of 5; for a true signal that is positive in each year with probability 0.8, 4 of 4 passes with probability 0.41 while at least 4 of 5 would pass with 0.74, so NO_SIGNAL is the likely label for a modest real effect and the rule favours few false positives on known-used data. Limits of the significance calibration: it is synthetic; the null models are a series-level AR(1) with a one-day moving-average overlap term and a structural hourly panel with 24-bar labels, and real increments may depend in ways neither model has (long memory, breaks, days missing in runs), and serial dependence above an AR coefficient of 0.3 was not studied; the Student-t reference is exact only for Gaussian white noise and approximate otherwise; cross-cell dependence was studied only as positive dependence, under which Benjamini-Hochberg was conservative; the 20-day moving-block interval of the D4 payoff was not calibrated and is the same kind of bootstrap that v3 used; the day span of the decisive series (all out-of-sample days or the four full years) is not restricted by the protocol text, and both 1460 and 1948 days were calibrated. This packet is UNREVIEWED. SD2 runner interpretations of an ambiguous protocol, open to reviewer challenge: the drift baseline admits a label that matures exactly at the refit instant while the model training set (the shared causal builder) excludes it; the pooled year increment is the mean of the year's valid daily increments on the demeaned target; the symbol slice reports the forecast's own within-symbol rank IC because the drift is constant within a symbol-day; D4 and D5 follow stop_when_upper_layer_stops (D4 only for a cell that clears both BH gates and the year rule); models are fitted at the primary horizon and the primary transform only, so the secondary horizons and the raw transform appear in the reported D2 layer only; the label of a row whose price bars were not available at their own timestamp is dropped; the Ridge inner CV is computed from moments and pinned equal to the shared Ridge fit by test; one invocation performs the layers the protocol assigns to SD2 and to SD3 because its decisive cells need the fits and its budget is one run; the G4 authorization is a comment URL the runner cannot authenticate, bound to the protocol digest. The leakage probe is a seeded falsifier on synthetic bars and does not cover the 4h/1d aggregation and alignment; the label-copy screen finds only crude leaks. The manifest bound cannot prove the first or last timestamp by itself: coverage is established by the pinned digests (bytes with them are the already consumed development Dataset) together with the bar-count bound, and every bar is checked again after the load. The arrays file is hashed in discarded chunks before it is parsed. The runner was verified on synthetic panels only. No economic result, real price or return was read. This packet is UNREVIEWED
thesis.metric_proxy_rationale: Primary metric: the out-of-sample daily rank-IC increment over the drift baseline with Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment (q = 0.10; Holm FWER also reported). The p-value behind that gate is frozen in the protocol: a one-sided test of a mean daily rank-IC increment above zero (null: mean <= 0) by the equal-weighted cosine test, whose long-run variance is the average of the squared projections on the first floor(0.4 * n ** (2 / 3)) cosine functions (51 for 1460 days; the estimate smooths over at least four days, more than the one-day overlap of 24-bar labels) and whose statistic is referred to a Student-t law with that many degrees of freedom; it is deterministic (no resampling, no seed) and returns exactly 1.0 for a non-positive mean, for fewer than four eligible days including none, and for a constant series. The correction is applied separately to the raw-target and the demeaned-target p-values, each over exactly the same 16 decision cells. The test replaces the centred moving-block bootstrap of the superseded v3 because of a result-blind synthetic calibration (docs/architecture/research-assurance.md (SD0 significance calibration)): at 1460 days, across serial dependence, label overlap, heavy tails and cross-cell correlation, the v3 bootstrap rejected a true global null in 11 to 13 percent of families at q = 0.10 when cells were independent and its per-test size was above nominal in every configuration, while the frozen test stayed within three Monte Carlo standard errors of nominal in all 15 configurations on two independent seeds at a dense-scenario power of 0.83 against 0.85 to 0.86 with independent cells. Guardrails: the same increment must hold on the cross-sectionally demeaned target and be positive in each of the four full calendar years 2022-2025 (each with 12 months of at least 15 valid daily increments), and a simple after-cost threshold-rule payoff relative to a zero-cost drift-sign policy (fee 5 bp plus spread 2 bp per side, round trip 14 bp) must have a 20-day moving-block-bootstrap interval (2000 resamples, seed 0, 95%) excluding zero at cost x1 and a positive point at cost x2. These are screening proxies, not profit: the cost model has no impact, funding, risk layer or canonical ledger, and at most three frozen candidates would be checked against native replay in a later card
thesis.stop_rule: Stop the current-feature decision-learning line on NO_SIGNAL. The protocol budget is a single run with every cell saved: do not rerun after a result, do not add features, horizons, targets, models, penalties, k, cost multipliers, thresholds or candidates after any result is seen (a new protocol version with the full exploration history is the only path), and do not retune the #1025 learner on this data. A failing cell halts the run with no verdict and consumes it; it is not retried silently. Running needs a separate owner G4 lease and an independent result-blind review of the protocol digest and this packet by a different model from claude-opus-5-5, claude-fable-5-1, claude-fable-5-2 and claude-sonnet-5-5; without both, stop at synthetic verification. Never touch 2026-08-01T00:00Z onward (the FS1 warm-up span and the sealed window)
